lines: Treasury yields remain the dominant cross-asset driver, with futures swinging between flat, lower, and higher across headlines as yields rise and fall, keeping index futures choppy into the cash open [cb4239efba][4ca01903d8][66f28c7516][2f7cc76440][be9334a6b1].

Fed minutes are the key risk event traders are positioning around, cited across nearly every futures headline as the reason for cautious, muted price action [cb4239efba][3405255088][be9334a6b1][69bd57f12f].

A soft September jobs report is feeding hopes for a Fed pause, pressuring yields lower at times and lifting gold, with futures reacting positively in at least one headline [3405255088][5fa9017001][578d5f29cb].
Broad inflation concerns are separately cited as keeping stocks under pressure via the yields channel, reinforcing the same rates narrative rather than a new catalyst [ada49fcde7].
